slides.title: Luna Sees the Clouds
slides.text: Luna Owl flew high above Sunny Forest. Her soft lavender-grey wings moved gently. She saw big white clouds in the sky. "What are those clouds doing today?" she thought. "Every question opens a new adventure!" she said softly.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Luna flying and her curiosity about clouds.

slides.title: Clouds Change Shape
slides.text: The clouds moved very slowly. Some looked like big fluffy sheep. Some looked like small, soft feathers. Luna saw one change into a friendly smile. "Why do clouds change their shapes?" Luna wanted to know.
slides.speaker_notes: Show clouds changing forms and Luna's growing curiosity.

slides.title: A Book for Answers
slides.text: Luna remembered a special book. It was at the Old Oak Library. "Perhaps a book knows about clouds!" she chirped. She flapped her wings a little faster. She flew towards her favorite place to learn.
slides.speaker_notes: Luna decides to seek answers at the library, showing initiative.

slides.title: Secrets of the Sky
slides.text: At the library, Luna found a colourful book. It was called "Sky Secrets." She opened it with her beak. The book said: "Clouds are tiny water drops! Wind makes them move and change." Luna understood!
slides.speaker_notes: Luna finds the answer in a book, solving her small challenge.

slides.title: Happy and Smart
slides.text: Luna felt happy and smart. Now she knew about clouds! The sky looked even more amazing. "There is so much to learn!" she hooted softly. She smiled, ready for her next big question.
slides.speaker_notes: Luna feels satisfied with her discovery and remains curious for more.

publishing.instagram_caption_long:
Ever wondered why clouds change shape? 🦉 Our wise and gentle Luna Owl is flying high above Sunny Forest when she spots the big white clouds changing right before her eyes! Her curious heart starts asking questions, and soon she's off on a little adventure to find the answers.

This sweet story helps children learn about weather in a simple, engaging way and shows how asking questions can lead to wonderful discoveries. It's a reminder that every day offers a chance to learn something new about the world around us. Perfect for sparking your little one's own curiosity about the sky!
